subject.title: Feature: Global session reset on auth switch

question: When credentials change for a provider/profile used by retained native or CLI sessions, should matching active runs be cancelled immediately or allowed to drain before their bindings are invalidated?
rationale: Embedded provider turns already load current auth per run; the unresolved choice governs retired-credential lifetime and continuity for retained native runtime sessions.

options.title: Cancel and invalidate
options.body: Cancel matching active runs, invalidate only affected native bindings, and preserve the OpenClaw transcript for the next turn.

options.title: Drain then invalidate
options.body: Allow matching runs to finish with old credentials before invalidating bindings for subsequent turns.

options.title: Manual refresh RPC
options.body: Keep auth mutation separate and require an admin-scoped provider/profile refresh action after credential changes.

recommendation.title: Cancel and invalidate
recommendation.body: Cancel matching active runs, invalidate only affected native bindings, and preserve the OpenClaw transcript for the next turn.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest combined signal from direct issue discussion and repeated auth/session lifecycle history.
